definitions.source_rows: All physical lines, including malformed/blank lines; valid_rows+malformed_rows.
definitions.duplicates: Compared numerically against the first valid record at that file/timestamp; no values are added or repaired.
definitions.conflict_mask: Every timestamp with any conflicting or timestamped-invalid record is ambiguous; all observations at that key are excluded from primary group-validity and simultaneous-span diagnostics. Bad-only timestamps are listed in record_masks/SQLite bad_keys; ambiguous_timestamps lists keys also having valid observations.
definitions.mode: Mode of positive deltas between sorted unique parsed timestamps; ties select the smallest delta. Descriptive, not a certified acquisition cadence.
definitions.elapsed_span: Last minus first unique parsed timestamp. No extra endpoint sample duration is assumed.
definitions.threshold_connected_span: Sum of consecutive sorted-unique timestamp deltas <=T; longer deltas excluded entirely. Connected+long_interval_seconds equals elapsed span.
definitions.unambiguous_connected_span: Same, excluding intervals with a conflicting or timestamped-invalid key at either endpoint or between the endpoints; known invalid/conflicting keys never bridged. CSV conflict_touched fields include timestamped-invalid records.
definitions.simultaneous_span: Intersection of per-channel unambiguous unions of half-open bounded-gap spans [t_i,t_(i+1)) for delta<=T. This is not measured continuous uptime.
definitions.mains_window: Minimum first to maximum last timestamp across the two mains channels; common window is maximum first to minimum last across required channels.
definitions.densities: Ratios of source timestamps or bounded-gap spans, not raw sensor-loss/error rates, physical synchronization/clock offsets, energy, or NILM accuracy.
definitions.mains_preservation: Raw files are read only; no imputation, alignment repair, submeter-derived MAIN reconstruction, or physical measurand assertion occurs.
